age.evidence: Adult male and timed-pregnant Sprague-Dawley rats were purchased from BioLASCO, Taipei, Taiwan.

sex.evidence: the protective effect of psilocybin was examined in male animals in this study.

dosing.evidence: psilocybin (100 µM x 20 µL, n = 7) or vehicle (saline, 20 µl, n = 7) was administered intracerebroventricularly (i.c.v.) ... at 15 min before the right middle cerebral artery occlusion (MCAo)... In the post-treatment group, psilocybin (1 mg/kg/day, n = 7) or vehicle (n = 6) was administered i.p. from day 3 to day 7.

enrichment_housing.evidence: All experiment procedures, including housing and husbandry conditions, environmental enrichment, animal care/monitoring, and humane endpoints, were carried out in accordance with the National Institutes of Health Guidelines (no specific enrichment items described).

assays.assay_name: Neurological Deficit Tests (Bederson's score + Elevated Body Asymmetry Test)
assays.assay_description: Rats suspended by the tail above the testing table: elevated body asymmetry (contralateral turns in 20 consecutive trials) and Bederson's postural reflex score (0-3). Conducted on D2 after MCAo (i.c.v. pretreatment cohort, ± intranasal ANA12) and on D9 (i.p. post-treatment cohort, days 3-7).

application_type.evidence: psilocybin ... was administered intracerebroventricularly (i.c.v.) ... psilocybin (1 mg/kg/day) ... was administered i.p. from day 3 to day 7.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were examined for lateral movements/turning when their bodies were suspended 20 cm above the testing table by lifting their tails.

food_restriction.evidence: No food present during tail-suspension testing on the testing table.

water_restriction.evidence: No water present during tail-suspension testing on the testing table.

time_to_assay.evidence: Psilocybin (Psi) was given (i.c.v.) 15 min before the MCAo on D0 ... Behavioral tests were conducted on D2; post-treatment: psilocybin given daily between days 3 and 7 ... Neurological and locomotor tests were conducted on day 9 (~2 days after last dose in both cohorts).

sample_size.evidence: Pretreatment: 4 non-stroke, Psi n=7, veh n=7, ANA12 n=7 (F 3,21); post-treatment: Psi n=7, vehicle n=6, 'Four non-stroke rats were used as naive controls' (F 2,14).

outcomes.summary: Stroke increased Bederson's score and body asymmetry. Psilocybin given i.c.v. before MCAo (tested D2) or i.p. on days 3-7 post-MCAo (tested D9) significantly reduced both deficits; intranasal ANA12 antagonized the pretreatment effect.
outcomes.statistics: Pretreatment: Bederson p = 0.011 (F 3,21 = 16.411), body asymmetry p = 0.002 (F 3,21 = 23.904); ANA12 B1 p = 0.012, B2 p = 0.012. Post-treatment: Bederson p = 0.024 (F 2,14 = 16.344), body asymmetry p = 0.026 (F 2,14 = 16.321); one-way ANOVA + NK test.
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin significantly reduced the Bederson's neurological score (Fig. 3-B1, p = 0.011, one-Way ANOVA + NK test) and body asymmetry (Fig. 3-B2, p = 0.002, stroke + veh vs. stroke + Psi). ... Psilocybin significantly reduced neurological deficits (Fig. 5B1, Bederson's neurological score, p = 0.024; B2: body asymmetry, p = 0.026)

B1_num_measures.evidence: Bederson's neurological score and body asymmetry (contralateral turns/20 trials).

B4_ethological.evidence: Postural reflex and turning on tail suspension are neurological reflex measures, not ethological behaviours.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Univariate one-way ANOVA + NK test only.

E1_environment_type.evidence: suspended 20 cm above the testing table

E7_social_context.evidence: Individual rats suspended by the tail and scored.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water during testing.

D1_continuity.evidence: Two behavioral tests were conducted two days (or D2) after the MCAo ... Behavioral tests were conducted on day 9 (separate cohorts).

D2_session_duration.evidence: not reported (20 consecutive trials; no session duration stated)

D3_recording_days.evidence: Tests on D2 (pretreatment cohort) and day 9 (post-treatment cohort).

D5_followup.evidence: Tests on D2 after i.c.v. dosing on D0, and on day 9 after last i.p. dose on day 7 (>=24 h).

assays.assay_description: Rats individually placed in a 3D infrared behavior chamber (Accuscan, 42 × 42 × 21 cm) for 60 min; HACTV, TOTDIST, MOVNO, MOVTIME recorded. Conducted on D2 (i.c.v. pretreatment ± ANA12 cohort) and D9 (i.p. post-treatment cohort).

application_type.evidence: psilocybin ... was administered intracerebroventricularly (i.c.v.) ... psilocybin (1 mg/kg/day) ... was administered i.p. from day 3 to day 7.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were individually placed in a 3D infrared behavior chamber (42 × 42 × 21 cm) for 60 min.

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the activity chamber.

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the activity chamber.

time_to_assay.evidence: Locomotor activity was monitored for one hour on day 2 (i.c.v. dose on D0); post-treatment psilocybin days 3-7, tests on day 9.

sample_size.evidence: Pretreatment: 4 non-stroke, Psi n=7, veh n=7, ANA12 n=7 (F 3,21); post-treatment: Psi n=7, vehicle n=6, 4 non-stroke controls (F 2,14).

outcomes.summary: Stroke reduced locomotor activity. Pre-stroke i.c.v. psilocybin increased HACTV, TOTDIST and MOVNO (MOVTIME marginal) on D2, with ANA12 antagonizing HACTV and TOTDIST effects; post-stroke i.p. psilocybin increased all four parameters on D9.
outcomes.statistics: Pretreatment: HACTV p = 0.039, TOTDIST p = 0.032, MOVNO p = 0.0284, MOVTIME p = 0.056; ANA12: HACTV p = 0.009, TOTDIST p = 0.018. Post-treatment: HACTV p = 0.009 (F 2,14 = 6.887), TOTDIST p = 0.009 (F 2,14 = 5.848), MOVNO p = 0.022 (F 2,14 = 4.883), MOVTIME p = 0.02 (F 2,14 = 7.691); one-way ANOVA + NK test.
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin increased horizontal activity (HACTV, p = 0.039), total distance traveled (TOTODIST, p = 0.032), and movement number (MOVNO, p = 0.0284) as well as marginally increased movement time (MOVTIME, p = 0.056; Fig. 3C1-4).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Four parameters were recorded: HACTV, TOTDIST, MOVNO, MOVTIME.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only session totals over 60 min reported.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in chamber.

D1_continuity.evidence: Locomotor activity was monitored for one hour on day 2 ... Behavioral tests were conducted on day 9 (separate cohorts).

D2_session_duration.evidence: Rats were individually placed in a 3D infrared behavior chamber (42 × 42 × 21 cm) for 60 min.

D5_followup.evidence: Tests on D2 after D0 i.c.v. dosing and on day 9 after last i.p. dose on day 7.

judge_notes: Merged deepseek4's separate 'EBST' and 'Bederson's Neurological Test' into one Neurological Deficit Tests assay, following the modal (2/3) candidate granularity; both are tail-suspension neurological scoring on the testing table and are reported together.
Corrected gemma4's B1 score for neurological tests (2-3 measures = 1 point) and locomotor (4 measures = 4-6, 2 points).
time_to_assay set to short_term_1to7d (~2880 min) for both assays: i.c.v. given D0 with testing D2; i.p. last dose day 7 with testing day 9. Not 'early_2to24h' (deepseek4) since interval is ~48 h.
setup_restrain = yes for neurological tests because rubric lists tail-suspension as restraint (modal 2/3).

Sample size n_total estimated as 42 from ANOVA dfs (F3,21 pretreatment incl. ANA12 group = 25; F2,14 post-treatment = 17); text states 18 for the pretreatment analysis excluding ANA12 group, hence medium confidence.
D1/D3 kept at modal 'Multiple'/2-7 although D2 and D9 tests were in separate cohorts (each animal tested once).
D2 for neurological tests scored 0 with low confidence — no session duration stated.
Dosing consolidated into one Psilocybin entry with route 'multiple' (i.c.v. single pre-stroke dose; i.p. 1 mg/kg/day × 5 days); i.c.v. dose given as 100 µM × 20 µL, not convertible to mg/kg.
